text:
sam (SE): Hey team — Acme trial is blocked. Two things: logs set to export to customer S3 but nothing shows up, and the trace IDs we're seeing in the Redwood console don't match the IDs the customer reports. Also they hit intermittent 429s during scale tests. Can we swarm?

maria (AE): pinged them for the S3 bucket policy and KMS ARN. They said they enforce a strict KMS key policy (only allow specific principals). Could be a cross-account PutObject blocked. :thinking_face:

hunter (infra): likely KMS policy or the IAM role for the export lambda. Quick checks: run `aws s3api head-object --bucket <bucket> --key <prefix>/some-sample.json` and `aws sts get-caller-identity` from our export runner. If head-object 403 or access denied -> permissions. Also `aws kms get-key-policy --key-id <key-id>` to validate.

sam (SE): here's the minimal failing log from the export runner (sanitized):
```
{"time":"2025-11-02T18:22:13Z","level":"error","msg":"s3 upload failed","error":"AccessDenied: Access Denied","request_id":"rwd-req-9a7b","attempt":3}
```
They also shared app traces where the client's trace id is `client-4f2b` but in our console the span shows `rwd-req-9a7b`.

hunter (infra): that mismatch is expected: we generate an internal request_id for routing. We should propagate the client's trace id in the export and the logs (X-Request-ID style). Ask the customer to include their trace id in the incoming header `X-Client-Trace` and then add this mapping in the exporter: `request_id = headers['X-Client-Trace'] || internal_request_id`. Quick curl example to test propagation:
```bash
curl -v -H "X-Client-Trace: client-4f2b" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
If you see `client-4f2b` in our log stream, mapping works.

ben (SE): also seeing 429s in the same window: sample snippet from their load test logs shows repeated 429s from our ingest endpoint and retries causing export backpressure. We should confirm throttling configs for the Dedicated trial and whether they hit bursts over their reserved capacity.

sam (SE): customer asked: will outbound S3 egress be billed to them or Redwood? It's in the contract but they want confirmation before enabling exports. Maria, can you confirm pricing path? :pray:

maria (AE): quick answer: for trials we cover outbound within the free-tier export allowance; beyond that it's in the Dedicated addendum (per-GB egress). I'll escalate to pricing to confirm exact thresholds and send a note.

hunter (infra): temporary mitigation for 429s: enable adaptive batching lower TTL and enable retry jitter on exporter. In config: `batch.max_delay_ms=25, retry.backoff_jitter=true`. Also add a fallback export queue (SQS) to decouple ingestion from export spikes.

sam (SE): customer also asked about security questionnaire item 7 (KMS practices) — they want the key usage flow documented. I uploaded a doc to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/r/acme-security/KMS-answers (customer link).

ben (SE): I'll take the ownership for the security questionnaire response and fill in the KMS flow diagram. Maria will follow up on billing. Hunter can help with the short-term export config.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for export-runner v2025-11-02-07 (id: canary-874). Status: in-progress.

sam (SE): action items: 1) Maria confirm pricing + notify customer, 2) Hunter validate KMS policy with the customer (can we get their key-id?), 3) Ben to update security questionnaire answers, 4) Ops to monitor 429s and enable temporary batching changes. Who can reach out to customer infra for running the `head-object` and `kms get-key-policy`?

hunter (infra): I can take the `head-object` on a call with them in 30m. Send the support invite.

maria (AE): invite sent. Also asked them to open a support window for 1 hour so we can test live. :thumbsup:

sam (SE): Great — if we confirm it's KMS policy we can provide a short policy snippet they can add:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDDENED:role/redwood-exporter"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Change the Principal to their exporter role.

ben (SE): I'm drafting the security questionnaire text now and will paste the section here when done.

sam (SE): thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If we get a quick successful head-object and see client-4f2b in logs, we'll mark as resolved.

maria (AE): update — customer ran head-object with our guidance and got 403. They shared the KMS key id, I'm looping hunter.

hunter (infra): confirmed KMS key policy denies cross-account decrypt. Requested they add exporter role ARN. After they do that we'll re-run and should see successful S3 PUTs.

sam (SE): nice. I'll draft a short note for the customer about next steps and include the pricing heads-up.

maria (AE): closing loop later with the SOC contact for the questionnaire.

ben (SE): pasted draft answer for KMS usage (will attach final doc to the support ticket).

sam (SE): closing note here once export validated or if 429s persist. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
